notes.title: Version 4.9 MAJOR UPDATE
notes.notes:
[i]Event Period: 5/28/2025 (Post Maintenance)～[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33596455/527604c9dfe054da6469b5d35ea6285c0516330c.png[/img]

Senpai!

[b]At long last, it's here! Version 4.9, the last of the TENGOKU: Four Towers series![/b]



[h2][b]1) NEO M.I.L.K Area Revealed! [/b][/h2]
[i]Event Period: 5/28/2025 (Post Maintenance)～[/i]

After the maintenance on 5/28, for those of you that have made it to Floor 100 of TENGOKU, you’ll be presented with an escalator on Floor 51 that leads to the NEO M.I.L.K area.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33596455/821244e31f8fd50bc3e081931d8dd8c2ad5c3bf2.jpg[/img]

The NEO M.I.L.K area coming this patch is an extremely challenging area where all enemies are significantly strengthened, even by TENGOKU standards. Within the area, all M.I.L.K armor and weapons will receive a large faction bonus buff to their stats. It is highly recommended that players bring all M.I.L.K equipment when stepping up to this challenge. But select your items carefully before climbing up these floors; there will be a limit to the number of items you can take in your Death Bag.

Of course, with an immense challenge comes immense rewards. Within the area, players have increased chances of obtaining rare M.I.L.K metals, and the equipment obtained here is of similar quality to that of TENGOKU Floor 100.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33596455/d8c0e18e8cdb6121c26398fa2cfa57fc7c226f10.jpg[/img]



[h2][b]2) Pale Wind (HELL) Unleashed! [/b][/h2]
[i]Event Period: 5/28/2025 (Post Maintenance)～[/i]

The NEO M.I.L.K area features a new difficulty of a returning boss: Pale Wind of the 4 FORCEMEN can now be fought at the "HELL" difficulty! He'll appear every 10 floors that you progress within the NEO M.I.L.K area.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33596455/91ea0d6ac1924431f394b69def06f1ab73cfe19d.jpg[/img]

Defeat this high-difficulty FORCEMEN for rare items and new blueprints! Luckily, the "HELL" difficulty has no battle fee and no time limit during battles. However, if you are defeated, there will be a corpse retrieval cost.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33596455/edce1bc55efd03c7816d26df374e0504cf23e56b.jpg[/img]



[h2][b]3) Bloodnium Limit Increased! [/b][/h2]
[i]Event Period: 5/28/2025 (Post Maintenance)～[/i]

The Bloodnium limit has been increased from 99999  to 999999!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33596455/8314943f0a08b115b3fa25a137f4b32b15eff07f.jpg[/img]



[h2][b]4) NEO M.I.L.K Area Opening Event Will Be Held at the Same Time! [/b][/h2]
[i]Event Period: 5/28/2025 (Post Maintenance) – 6/30/2025 (Until Maintenance Begins)[/i]

[url=https://www.letitdiethegame.com/news.html#/7360/]Click here for more information[/url]



NOTE
*Please note that event duration and content may be subject to change due to unforeseen circumstances.

notes.title: Version 4.0 MAJOR UPDATE
notes.notes:
[i]Event Period: 11/29/2023 (Post Maintenance) - TBD[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33596455/0500afe39edb1f2ab0c8b37a70562159625e8904.jpg[/img]

Senpai!

[b]At long last, it's here! Version 4.0 with a major update![/b]

Honestly, I was convinced there wouldn't be any more big updates... This is all thanks to all you senpai who have continued playing the game! Thanks, y'all!

After years of hard work, a new area is finally releasing: the NEO D.O.D. area! The NEO D.O.D. area is a brand new high-difficulty area where all enemies are significantly strengthened. It's a high risk, high reward challenge that adrenaline junkies are bound to  love.

By the way, it seems that you can't challenge the NEO D.O.D. area unless you've reached TENGOKU 100F, so if you haven't done that yet, go conquer TENGOKU first! I'll be waiting!



[h2][b]1) NEO D.O.D. Area Revealed![/b][/h2]
[i]Event Period: 11/29/2023 (Post Maintenance) - TBD[/i]

After the maintenance on 11/29, for those of you that have made it to Floor 100 of TENGOKU, you’ll be presented with an escalator on Floor 51 that leads to the NEO D.O.D. area.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33596455/cf04277e9f8cd8955ed63722fd6ad4952e65af2b.jpg[/img]

The Neo D.OD. area coming this patch is an extremely challenging area where all enemies are significantly strengthened, even by TENGOKU standards. Within the area, all D.O.D. armor and weapons will receive a large faction bonus buff to their stats. It is highly recommended that players bring all D.O.D. equipment when stepping up to this challenge. But select your items carefully before climbing up these floors; there will be a limit to the number of items you can take in your Death Bag.

Of course, with an immense challenge comes immense rewards. Within the area, players have increased chances of obtaining rare D.O.D. ARMS metals, and the equipment obtained here is of similar quality to that of TENGOKU floor 100.

NOTE                                                                                                                                    
*Other faction stages will also be releasing in future updates.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33596455/d0cdcd79d31edb49e171925d40cd146edf8f9478.jpg[/img]



[h2][b]2) White Steel (HELL) Unleashed![/b][/h2]
[i]Event Period: 11/29/2023 (Post Maintenance) - TBD[/i]

The Neo D.O.D. area features a new difficulty of a returning boss: White Steel of the Four Forcemen can now be fought at the "HELL" difficulty! He'll appear every 10 floors that you progress within the NEO D.O.D. area.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33596455/cb99106ce079a04bcbd392c9fb0e384123fe6730.jpg[/img]

Defeat this high-difficulty Forcemen for rare items and new blueprints!

Unlike other difficulties, the "HELL" difficulty has no battle fee and no time limit during battles. However, if you are defeated, there will be a corpse retrieval cost.



[h2][b]3) Armor Skins In Shop![/b][/h2]
[i]Event Period: 11/29/2023 (Post Maintenance) - TBD[/i]

You'll now be able change the appearance of your Fighter's armor!

Armor Skins will be sliding into Let it Die with Version 4.0! The ability to set armor skins can be accessed by speaking to Kommodore Suzuki at the Choku-Funsha. You'll be able to select any armor enhanced up to +4 as armor skins, letting you conquer the tower with flair!

Armor skins only change the appearance of the armor. The performance of the skin will be the same as that of the armor you have equipped.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33596455/257db2edcf81fde96d9344eda085fa5347ad1bb6.jpg[/img]

The status of your armor skins can also be checked in the Option Menu. Armor skins can only be applied to the Fighter currently in play. Please note that "Armor Skins" will not be reflected on some screens, such as the floor results.
